secret_policy: No secret values, client secrets, private keys, tokens, mailbox credentials, or OAuth codes belong in this file.

gearswipe.required_state: Both apex and www remain production Custom Domains for the gearswipe Worker. No zone-route or DNS change is required for the Google callback.

goldshore_admin.required_state: Keep human roles separate from machine/service-token access. A Workspace email alias is mailbox-only until explicitly added to an authorization group.

public_pages.required_state: Only published-content reads may bypass Access. Admin and write routes remain application-authorized.

gearswipe.required_state: GearSwipe login has an OIDC-only client. Sensitive Google API integrations must not share its consent surface.

cutover.owner_action: Create the approved dedicated web OAuth client in the selected Google Cloud project through a secure owner session. Do not copy the client secret into chat, source, KV, or this file.
cutover.operator_action: Set AUTH_GOOGLE_ID and AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET through the Worker secret interface, deploy only after the owner confirms the secure secret handoff, then validate with a non-Workspace account.
cutover.rollback: Restore the previous AUTH_GOOGLE_ID and AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET bindings; retain the prior client until successful non-Workspace validation is recorded.

key_migrations.desired_state: one named workload identity or another non-key mechanism; revoke keys only after its consumer proves live access
identify the workload, replace its key dependency, then revoke after live validation
identify the workload, replace its key dependency, then revoke after live validation

worker_secret_migration.required_state: Map every direct token binding to a source consumer, human owner, rotation interval, test, and rollback before moving it to Secrets Store or a workload identity.

approval_gates.oauth_client_creation: Requires the selected GCP project, client name, branding/support contacts, and an owner-approved secure client-secret handoff.
approval_gates.worker_secret_cutover: Requires a value-free binding change plan plus a rollback owner.
approval_gates.service_account_key_revocation: Requires workload evidence, minimum IAM roles, and a successful live replacement test.
approval_gates.cloudflare_access_or_routing: No change is currently indicated; any future change requires a target application/route and a recovery test.
